ImageDescription.value:
This work depicts the scene in which Ninigi no Mikoto, the ancestral god of the Emperors, fell in love with Konohanasakuyahime, the daughter of Oyamatsumi no Kami, the god who governs the mountains. It depicts a moment of emotional connection between a young man and woman. This work was created when the artist was 22 years old, about five years after studying under Hashimoto Gaho, and was produced under the name Tenpu (his pen name at the time), when he won second place at the 5th Futaba Exhibition.
